caption:
Amul is really coming for every single snack in your pantry. 🧀 First it was high-protein lassi and kulfi, now it is crunchy protein snack cubes with kimchi and tandoori seasonings. At 80 rupees for 25 grams of protein, gym bros are definitely watching. Would you try this over your usual chips?

post.news: Amul launched savoury protein cubes packed with 25 grams of protein for 80 rupees. You mix in seasoning and shake the pack.
post.take: Amul spent decades feeding us butter just to sell us the gym diet afterwards. Pure business.
post.insight: Amul is aggressively turning everyday Indian snacking into a high-protein category before legacy health brands catch up.
